# Margo Engine

> Margo Engine is a WebGPU 3D engine for the web, written in TypeScript with a small Wasm kernel. `@margoengine/core` plus the stage facade (`margoengine`) stay under 25,000 bytes gzip; everything else (glTF PBR, animation, post-processing, physics, CAD, voxels, GPU compute, scientific visualisation) is a separate, optional, tree-shakable package. ESM only, full types, glTF and real-world units by default, `AbortSignal` on anything that loads, coded errors with a help link.

Import the stage for a canvas, camera, controls and loading in a few lines (`import { createStage } from "margoengine"`), or the engine for full control (`import { Engine } from "@margoengine/core"`). Add a feature by importing its package; `margoengine/<name>` and `@margoengine/<name>` are the same module. Without WebGPU, `@margoengine/webgl2-compat` runs the real renderer on WebGL2; its optional `/preview` entry draws basic scenes on lower-tier WebGL2. Margo is written clean room: it does not copy or adapt code from other engines. The `@margoengine/mcp` package is a Model Context Protocol server that gives AI tools these docs, a type-check for snippets and the example list.

## Start here

- [Full documentation as one file](https://margoengine.com/llms-full.txt): guides in full and each package README (long ones cut), for tools that take a single text
- [Package index](https://margoengine.com/catalog/): searchable list of every package, its imports and runtime exports
- [Error help](https://margoengine.com/errors): cause and fix for every coded error message
- [Examples](https://margoengine.com/llms/examples.md): runnable example pages and projects

## Guides

- [API overview](https://margoengine.com/llms/docs/api-overview.md): A short tour of the three levels (stage, engine, packages) with the code for each
- [Package conventions](https://margoengine.com/llms/docs/conventions.md): Naming, errors, units and the rules every package follows
- [A mobile-first architectural walkthrough in ~50 lines](https://margoengine.com/llms/docs/guides/walkthrough.md): Step-by-step first scene to a loaded model
- [Which import do I need?](https://margoengine.com/llms/docs/guides/imports.md): Which import to use: margoengine/<name> versus @margoengine/<name>
- [Quality tiers: one app that runs at 60 FPS on a laptop and looks its best on a fast PC](https://margoengine.com/llms/docs/guides/quality-tiers.md): High and low quality tiers and how a page picks one
- [Kits](https://margoengine.com/llms/docs/guides/kits.md): Independent install profiles for games, web, visualization and React
- [Starting from three.js](https://margoengine.com/llms/docs/guides/kit-migration.md): Install-to-frame review for developers coming from three.js
- [Prepare assets with margo-convert](https://margoengine.com/llms/docs/guides/asset-pipeline.md): margo-convert build: optimise, compress and package models for the web and for Unity, Unreal, Godot and Roblox
- [Coming from three.js](https://margoengine.com/llms/docs/from-threejs.md): Moving from three.js: the same task in Margo, name by name
- [Design envelope](https://margoengine.com/llms/docs/limits.md): Measured limits and sizes, with the commands that measure them
- [Known bugs and unverified features](https://margoengine.com/llms/docs/known-bugs.md): Open bugs with repro and cause
- [Using Margo with AI tools](https://margoengine.com/llms/docs/ai-tools.md): Using Margo with Claude, Cursor, Copilot and the @margoengine/mcp server

## Packages: Start here

- [@margoengine/stage](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/stage.md): The stage: createStage mounts a canvas, camera controls and rendering in five lines. Re-exported by margoengine.
- [@margoengine/core](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/core.md): WebGPU rendering and a Wasm transform kernel. WebGL2 is the optional @margoengine/webgl2-compat package.
- [@margoengine/game](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/game.md): Games: models, animation, light and shadow, sky, physics, audio, input, effects
- [@margoengine/web](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/web.md): Product viewers and 3D on web pages: a glTF model, studio light, orbit, HTML on top
- [@margoengine/viz](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/viz.md): Data and scientific visualization: figures and GPU compute, points, lines, splats, terrain, labels and text
- [@margoengine/react-kit](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/react-kit.md): React and Next.js web install profile
- [margoengine](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/margoengine.md): Margo Engine in one install: the stage and every package as margoengine/<name> (margoengine/gltf, margoengine/shadows, margoengine/physics, margoengine/react).

## Packages: Setup and diagnostics

- [@margoengine/math](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/math.md): Vector, quaternion, matrix, Euler, color, bounds, ray, plane and frustum math, one module per type.
- [@margoengine/quality](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/quality.md): Measured quality tiers: start light, time the GPU, remember full 4x quality only where it has headroom.
- [@margoengine/webgl2-compat](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/webgl2-compat.md): WebGL2 compatibility for browsers without WebGPU: install() runs the real renderer with a WebGPU-shaped device, WGSL translation and tiered compute. Optional /preview…
- [@margoengine/worker](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/worker.md): Runs Margo Engine in a Web Worker on an OffscreenCanvas: canvas transfer, resize, pixel ratio and input forwarding, so heavy scenes never block the page.
- [@margoengine/stats](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/stats.md): Allocation-free frame samples, DOM performance overlay, optional WebGPU timestamp profiling, pipeline compile tracking, a CPU phase breakdown, leak alerts and field…
- [@margoengine/inspector](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/inspector.md): Entity hierarchy, live properties, WebGPU wireframe, normal and bounding-box overlays, and a frame debugger.

## Packages: Loading and formats

- [@margoengine/gltf](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/gltf.md): Lazy static glTF/GLB loading for Margo Engine.
- [@margoengine/gltf-pro](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/gltf-pro.md): Opt-in glTF 2.0 metallic-roughness rendering for Margo Engine WebGPU.
- [@margoengine/loaders](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/loaders.md): PLY, STL, 3MF, PCD, OFF, XYZ, OBJ/MTL, COLLADA, Tiled TMX, VTK, NRRD, LDraw, Rhino 3DM, 3DS, LWO, AMF, MD2, PDB, KMZ, NURBS, LAS, OpenVDB, MaterialX, Lottie, static…
- [@margoengine/decoders](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/decoders.md): Worker-pooled Draco geometry and KTX2/Basis texture decoding, and synchronous PNG, TGA, TIFF, DDS and KTX reading, for Margo Engine.
- [@margoengine/fbx](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/fbx.md): Binary and ASCII FBX conversion into the optional Margo glTF animation pipeline.
- [@margoengine/usdz](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/usdz.md): Optional static USDA, USDC and USDZ ingestion through Margo glTF PBR.
- [@margoengine/exporters](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/exporters.md): glTF/GLB, STL, OBJ, PLY, USDZ, COLLADA and 3MF exporters for Margo Engine scenes and geometry data.
- [@margoengine/blender](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/blender.md): Optional offline Blender .margo assets using Margo's WebGPU PBR renderer.
- [@margoengine/cache](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/cache.md): Opt-in offline asset cache: a fetch-compatible IndexedDB cache for GLB, .bin and texture files with ETag/Last-Modified revalidation, app versioning, range requests, a…
- [@margoengine/splats](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/splats.md): Optional Gaussian splats with GPU covariance projection and stable compute radix sorting.
- [@margoengine/tiles](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/tiles.md): Streaming OGC 3D Tiles 1.1: implicit and explicit tilesets, screen-space-error selection, a fetch queue, a memory budget and glTF tiles drawn through gltf-pro.

## Packages: Rendering and lighting

- [@margoengine/materials](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/materials.md): Optional glTF PBR material lobes, transmission, volume, parallax occlusion, triplanar and subsurface scattering, and typed node graphs through an isolated extension slot.
- [@margoengine/shader](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/shader.md): Typed shader nodes that compile to readable WGSL: node materials, node post effects and node compute passes, with a visual node editor.
- [@margoengine/environment](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/environment.md): HDR/EXR/UltraHDR loading, EXR writing, image-based lighting (prefiltered specular, SH irradiance, BRDF LUT), environment backgrounds and scene fog for Margo Engine on…
- [@margoengine/clustered](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/clustered.md): WebGPU clustered forward point and spot lighting with optional local shadows.
- [@margoengine/shadows](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/shadows.md): Four-cascade cached directional shadows with PCSS.
- [@margoengine/lightmap](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/lightmap.md): CPU lightmap atlases with native albedo, emission, normal and ORM textures; triangle meshes at their own UV1 (./mesh), also progressively on the GPU (./gpu), with…
- [@margoengine/sky](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/sky.md): Procedural atmospheric skies, clouds, sun, moon, stars and weather (rain, snow, lightning).
- [@margoengine/weather](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/weather.md): Weather over time: a state machine with presets that blends rain, snow, hail, wind and lightning; a deterministic wind field; wet and snowy surface hooks in JavaScript…
- [@margoengine/toon](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/toon.md): Stepped diffuse shading and inverted-hull outlines.
- [@margoengine/oit](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/oit.md): Order-independent transparency for gltf-pro BLEND primitives and materials transparent meshes: weighted blending, moment-based blending, or exact per-pixel layer lists…
- [@margoengine/lod](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/lod.md): Level of detail with hysteresis and screen-size switching for thousands of instances, plus GPU-baked octahedral imposters drawn in one instanced call per atlas.
- [@margoengine/culling](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/culling.md): GPU-driven static instances: frustum and Hi-Z occlusion culling in compute, order-preserving compaction and indirect draws, no per-part CPU work per frame.
- [@margoengine/points](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/points.md): Large point clouds (PointCloud, PointsMaterial) and instanced sprites (SpriteBatch, SpriteMaterial) for Margo Engine, WebGPU.
- [@margoengine/sprites](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/sprites.md): 2D sprites at exact pixels: one instanced draw per layer, atlas rectangles, pivot, flip, rotation, tint, z and y sorting, integer pixel snapping and an optional normal…
- [@margoengine/lines](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/lines.md): Fat lines (Line, LineMaterial) and debug helpers for Margo Engine, WebGPU.
- [@margoengine/text](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/text.md): GPU signed distance field text for Margo Engine: runtime glyph atlases from any browser font, wrapping, alignment, outlines and shadows, WebGPU.
- [@margoengine/pixel](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/pixel.md): Pixel art rendering: a pixel camera with integer zoom and parallax, and a layer compositor that scales low-res layers by whole numbers and turns them with every output…
- [@margoengine/lighting2d](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/lighting2d.md): 2D lights for Margo Engine: point, spot and directional lights with normal-mapped shading and hard shadows from occluder edges, for pixel layers.
- [@margoengine/labels](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/labels.md): HTML labels and CSS 3D objects positioned over a Margo Engine canvas.
- [@margoengine/html](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/html.md): World-space DOM anchors, CSS3D placement and scene-depth occlusion.
- [@margoengine/video](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/video.md): WebGPU external video textures and optional Web Audio sampling.
- [@margoengine/xr](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/xr.md): Optional WebGPU WebXR sessions, input poses and stereo rendering for Margo Engine, with real-device runs (./device-check).
- [@margoengine/headless](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/headless.md): Render without a browser page: a stand-in canvas for core, GPU globals from the WebGPU binding you pass in, and readback to RGBA pixels or PNG bytes.
- [@margoengine/staging](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/staging.md): Product-shot staging: soft ground contact shadows (shadow-catcher plane) for core meshes and glTF models.

## Packages: Post-processing

- [@margoengine/post](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/post.md): HDR bloom, frame-graph SSAO, GTAO, SSGI and SSR, motion blur, lens flare, SMAA and FXAA, glitch and afterimage, and post-effect stacks for Margo Engine WebGPU.
- [@margoengine/tonemap](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/tonemap.md): Optional color grading: Khronos PBR Neutral (the engine default), AgX and ACES fitted curves, 2-65 cube LUTs.
- [@margoengine/dof](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/dof.md): Optional two-pass WebGPU depth of field with circular bokeh.
- [@margoengine/taa](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/taa.md): Optional temporal anti-aliasing with motion vectors and YCoCg history clamping.
- [@margoengine/transitions](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/transitions.md): WebGPU scene wipes, noise dissolves and chromatic displacement.

## Packages: World and effects

- [@margoengine/terrain](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/terrain.md): Geometry clipmaps and triplanar terrain layers.
- [@margoengine/biomes](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/biomes.md): Biome maps from a heightmap and a few climate settings: integer fixed-point climate fields, biome classification with smooth ecotones, presets, terrain ground weights…
- [@margoengine/voxel](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/voxel.md): Voxel worlds: a block-type registry, 32-cubed palette chunks with light bytes, and a chunked world with dirty tracking and change events.
- [@margoengine/voxel-pathtracer](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/voxel-pathtracer.md): Progressive WebGPU path tracer for instanced voxel models: diffuse, plastic, metal, glass, emissive, blended and volumetric materials, sun, sky, HDR environment and…
- [@margoengine/voxel-edit](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/voxel-edit.md): Editing voxel models for editors and tools: dense and sparse grids, modeling operations, brushes and selections, picking, export meshing, .vox scene editing and frame…
- [@margoengine/water](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/water.md): Gerstner water surfaces, terrain-coupled shallow-water flow, foam and spray.
- [@margoengine/scenery](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/scenery.md): Procedural moonlit skies and scenery passes for Margo Engine.
- [@margoengine/scatter](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/scatter.md): Seeded instancing, distance-based LOD and procedural wind.
- [@margoengine/road](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/road.md): Arc-length spline road surfaces, raised curbs and tiled UVs.
- [@margoengine/tilemap](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/tilemap.md): 2D tile maps for Margo Engine: the TileMapData format (tilesets, animated tiles, collision shapes, tile and object layers, parallax), a chunked renderer at exact…
- [@margoengine/vfx](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/vfx.md): GPU particle simulation and indirect billboards, with curves over life and sphere, cone and mesh-surface emitters.
- [@margoengine/creative](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/creative.md): WebGPU particles, atmosphere, toon shading and post-processing for Margo Engine.
- [@margoengine/procedural](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/procedural.md): Procedural cabins, foliage, grass, humanoids, Marching Cubes surfaces, seeded 2D/3D/4D noise, L-systems, Voronoi fracture and a bounded voxel expression language.
- [@margoengine/wfc](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/wfc.md): Seeded wave function collapse: 3D tile adjacency and the 2D overlapping (sample-based) model with backtracking.
- [@margoengine/splines](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/splines.md): 3D Catmull-Rom, Bezier, Hermite, B-spline and Kochanek-Bartels curves with arc-length lookup, closest point, stable frames and knot editing.

## Packages: Animation and interaction

- [@margoengine/animation](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/animation.md): Storage-buffer skinning and compute morph targets for Margo Engine.
- [@margoengine/animator](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/animator.md): Blend trees, additive layers, animation states, foot IK, CCD IK chains, root motion, and look-at and aim constraints.
- [@margoengine/kinematics-constraints](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/kinematics-constraints.md): Standalone analytical capsule, sphere and convex hull constraints for IK target and arm clearance.
- [@margoengine/rigging](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/rigging.md): Rigging and animation authoring: automatic skin weights, weight painting, skin checks, IK chains with poles, retarget presets, spring bones, VRM 1.0 avatars, geodesic…
- [@margoengine/tween](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/tween.md): Allocation-free numeric tween updates and easing timelines.
- [@margoengine/cinematic](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/cinematic.md): Virtual cameras with priorities and blends, framing, dolly tracks, group framing, camera noise, confiners and focus tracking, on top of damped follow, look-at and shake.
- [@margoengine/cutscene](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/cutscene.md): Cutscene timelines: camera, transform, property, animation, audio, subtitle and event tracks, nested timelines, scrubbing, a player that fires events in order, virtual…
- [@margoengine/controls](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/controls.md): Orbit, map, trackball, arcball, fly, first-person, pointer-lock and collision-aware walkthrough (/walk) camera controls, a transform gizmo and drag controls for Margo…
- [@margoengine/cameras](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/cameras.md): Orthographic projection and exactly vertical (top-down) views for the core camera, with matching culling and picking.
- [@margoengine/input](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/input.md): Semantic keyboard, pointer, gamepad, touch, gyro and pen actions with haptics, tap, hold, slow tap and double press rules, local multiplayer, and recording and replay.
- [@margoengine/ui](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/ui.md): Game UI drawn in the engine: menus, HUDs, health bars, inventories, dialogs and toasts with flex layout, theming, keyboard, gamepad and touch navigation, screen reader…
- [@margoengine/viewcube](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/viewcube.md): CAD view cube: shows the camera orientation and animates to top, front, side and isometric views, with a perspective/orthographic toggle.
- [@margoengine/selection](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/selection.md): GPU picking and visible mesh selection outlines.
- [@margoengine/audio](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/audio.md): Web Audio listener, global and positional sounds and a frequency analyser for Margo Engine.
- [@margoengine/mixer](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/mixer.md): Audio mixing and effects: buses with gain, mute, solo, sends and ducking; equaliser, filter, compressor, limiter, delay and reverb on Web Audio; positional emitters…

## Packages: Simulation and games

- [@margoengine/physics](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/physics.md): Rigid-body physics for Margo Engine on Rapier: fixed-step engine plugin with interpolation, colliders, joints, queries, events and a character controller.
- [@margoengine/physics2d](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/physics2d.md): 2D rigid-body physics for Margo Engine on Rapier: fixed-step plugin with interpolation, sprite-driven bodies, joints, queries, events, a character controller and tile…
- [@margoengine/ragdoll](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/ragdoll.md): Ragdolls on Margo physics: capsule bodies from a skeleton, cone and hinge joint limits, kinematic hit boxes, going limp and blending back to the animation.
- [@margoengine/navmesh](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/navmesh.md): Convex polygon navigation with A*, funnel paths and ORCA avoidance; navmesh generation from triangles (./build) tiled meshes that rebuild at run time (./tiles), baked…
- [@margoengine/ecs](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/ecs.md): Typed-array packed sparse-set entity component storage.
- [@margoengine/fsm](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/fsm.md): Hierarchical state machines with history, delayed transitions, parallel regions, JSON documents, snapshots and traces.
- [@margoengine/behavior](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/behavior.md): Game AI: behaviour trees with a typed blackboard and async tasks, utility-AI scoring, steering and flocking behaviours, perception (./perception), environment queries…
- [@margoengine/save](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/save.md): Save and load: versioned scene and world documents with stable ids, prefabs with overrides, migrations, all-or-nothing loading and storage adapters.
- [@margoengine/net](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/net.md): Hermite and quaternion snapshot interpolation with bounded prediction.
- [@margoengine/netcode](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/netcode.md): Game networking for any game: schema-first binary codec with delta snapshots, an authoritative fixed-timestep server, client prediction and reconciliation…
- [@margoengine/voxel-net](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/voxel-net.md): Multiplayer voxel worlds: an authoritative Node server on a hand-written WebSocket, a browser client with prediction and correction, and headless bots for load tests.

## Packages: Geometry and spatial

- [@margoengine/bvh](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/bvh.md): Triangle BVH, spatial queries and an engine Raycaster for Margo Engine.
- [@margoengine/geometry](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/geometry.md): Pure-CPU, tree-shakable geometry for Margo Engine: primitives, curves, shapes, extrusion, triangulation and mesh utilities.
- [@margoengine/mesh-edit](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/mesh-edit.md): Pure polygon editing with retained corner UVs, explicit topology provenance and conservative cleanup.
- [@margoengine/scene](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/scene.md): Scene graph conveniences for core meshes: children, traverse, userData, lookAt and world position, rotation and scale, as functions or as mesh members.

## Packages: Data and science

- [@margoengine/compute](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/compute.md): GPU compute without the WebGPU boilerplate, NumPy style: N-d arrays with views and broadcasting, fused expressions, reductions and statistics, scan, sort, selection…
- [@margoengine/sciviz](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/sciviz.md): Scientific visualisation for Margo Engine: volume rendering with transfer functions, slices and GPU isosurfaces, million-point scatter plots, surface and line plots…

## Packages: AI tools

- [@margoengine/mcp](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/mcp.md): A Model Context Protocol server for Margo Engine: AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) search the docs and API, read a package, list the examples and type-check a…

## Packages: Frameworks

- [@margoengine/react](https://margoengine.com/llms/packages/react.md): React 18/19 components and stable mesh refs for Margo Engine.
